status: Registered by integration 0059 unit A0 as the last two description and schema slots of the successor manifest, each component pinned by its generated sha256. The edits apply to the successor's own text composed before these two layers and before any capability binder (edits_apply_to), so every layer the successor adds before them (ports, IK selection, wait, the M6 screen) survives. Regenerate with `python -m ora.agent.composition.description_edits <this file>` whenever that text changes, then re-pin the manifest.

refusals_owned_elsewhere.finish_episode: policy_finish_outcomes_v2 (finish_outcomes_schema.description) writes finish_episode's whole description and input schema after every layer, so its Refused: sentence is generated there, with the codes agent/tools/finish_outcomes.py and finish_task_check.py raise; a layer edit would be overwritten.

public_text_zh_reference.note: 中文对照，仅供审阅；英文为权威文本，也是唯一投递给 Policy 的文本。每条 zh 只翻译该编辑新增或改动的文字，保留下来的锚定原句不重复翻译。

edits.before: On error: choose a saved step in the current round.
edits.after: On error: Refused: an empty or repeated views list or a view outside this tool's enum; history_point_ids naming a mark that is not solved; a step outside the current round's saved steps (invalid_arguments, naming that range); history_point_ids together with step. Choose a saved step in the current round.
edits.why: N2: the ex-ante refusals this tool's handler enforces
edits.zh: 拒绝：views 为空、重复或含本工具枚举之外的视角；history_point_ids 指向未求解的标记；step 不在当前回合已保存的步之内（invalid_arguments，并给出该范围）；history_point_ids 与 step 同时给出。

edits.before: On error: a malformed call — unequal lengths, a repeated name, more than eight entries, or a view that cannot be marked — is refused whole and names the field, while a pixel that cannot be measured fails only its own entry and leaves the rest solved.
edits.after: On error: Refused: a call with more than eight entries, point_ids and points_uv of unequal lengths, a repeated or empty name, a name longer than 64 characters, a negative pixel coordinate, or a view that cannot be marked; the whole call is refused and the refusal names the field. A pixel that cannot be measured fails only its own entry and leaves the rest solved.
edits.why: N2: list every whole-call refusal of mark_point_batch.py, including the 64-character name bound (mark_point_schema._MAX_POINT_ID_CHARS) that was stated only in the schema
edits.zh: 拒绝：超过八个条目、point_ids 与 points_uv 长度不等、名字重复或为空、名字超过 64 个字符、像素坐标为负，或视角不可标记；整个调用被拒绝，拒绝信息会指明字段。无法测量的像素只让它自己的条目失败，其余条目照常求解。

edits.before: On error: send exactly one of points, region or world_points_m -- none or two is refused and the message names all three.
edits.after: On error: Refused: none or two of points, region and world_points_m, with a message naming all three; a camera outside the fixed list; a step that names no saved observation (invalid_arguments, naming the saved range); more than sixteen points or world points, or a non-finite world coordinate; window_px outside 0 to 15; a pixel outside the image, which refuses the whole call rather than its entry; a rectangle that leaves the image or does not have x0<x1 and y0<y1.
edits.why: N2: the whole-call refusals of RobotToolRuntime._geometry, including window_px 0-15 and the one out-of-image pixel that refuses the whole call
edits.zh: 拒绝：points、region、world_points_m 一个都没给或给了两个（信息会列出这三者）；相机不在固定列表中；step 不对应任何已保存的观测（invalid_arguments，并给出已保存的范围）；点或世界点超过十六个，或世界坐标不是有限值；window_px 不在 0 到 15 之间；任一像素在图像之外——这会拒绝整个调用，而不只是该条目；矩形超出图像，或不满足 x0<x1 且 y0<y1。

edits.before: On error: read field, received and constraints, then change that input.
edits.after: On error: Refused: a block beyond the Limits below; a construct outside the evaluator grammar; an unknown, reserved or underscore-prefixed name; a string literal longer than 32 characters; a binding whose from is blank or longer than 120 characters; an output name the block never assigned; a non-finite result, or no numeric result at all. Each refusal is invalid_arguments; read its field, received and constraints, then change that input.
edits.why: N2: the evaluator's refusals, including the 32-character string literal bound (compute.py) and the 120-character from bound (compute_arguments.MAX_ORIGIN_CHARACTERS) the help did not state
edits.zh: 拒绝：超出下文 Limits 的代码块；求值器语法之外的结构；未知、保留或以下划线开头的名字；超过 32 个字符的字符串字面量；from 为空或超过 120 个字符的绑定；代码块从未赋值的输出名；非有限的结果，或根本没有数值结果。每种拒绝都是 invalid_arguments；读取其 field、received 与 constraints，然后修改该输入。

edits.before: On error: correct the named input or source.
edits.after: On error: Refused: no point or more than eight; a point outside the source image, which refuses the whole call; max_candidates outside 1 to 3; a camera outside this tool's enum; a step outside the current round's saved steps (invalid_arguments, naming that range); a request the segmentation service rejects (invalid_arguments, with the service's detail). Correct the named input or source.
edits.why: N2: the ex-ante refusals this tool's handler enforces
edits.zh: 拒绝：没有点或超过八个点；任一点在源图像之外——这会拒绝整个调用；max_candidates 不在 1 到 3 之间；相机不在本工具枚举中；step 不在当前回合已保存的步之内（invalid_arguments，并给出该范围）；分割服务拒绝的请求（invalid_arguments，附服务给出的说明）。

edits.before: On error: reject a candidate whose overlay or mask is dominated by table,
edits.after: On error: Refused: max_candidates outside 1 to 3, before any request is sent; text that is empty after trimming or longer than 120 characters; a camera outside this tool's enum; no grounding service (grounding_unavailable); a request the grounding service rejects (invalid_arguments, with the service's detail). Reject a candidate whose overlay or mask is dominated by table,
edits.why: N2: the ex-ante refusals this tool's handler enforces
edits.zh: 拒绝：max_candidates 不在 1 到 3 之间（在发出任何请求之前）；去除首尾空白后为空、或超过 120 个字符的 text；相机不在本工具枚举中；没有可用的 grounding 服务（grounding_unavailable）；grounding 服务拒绝的请求（invalid_arguments，附服务给出的说明）。

edits.before: Close-up previews are capped at the first six across a step: the request window holds 24 images and refuses rather than dropping the oldest.
edits.after: Every returned region gets its own close-up preview; nothing caps previews across a step, and no count of images already in the conversation refuses this call.
edits.why: N1 mismatch (1): no per-step preview cap exists (GROUNDING_PREVIEW_RENDER_LIMIT is per call and never binds at three regions) and nothing refuses at 24 images (trigger_inline_images is a soft trigger)
edits.zh: 每个返回的区域都有自己的特写预览；同一步内的预览没有上限，对话中已有图像的数量也不会让本调用被拒绝。

edits.before: On error: obtain a better current view or select another target or candidate.
edits.after: On error: Refused: a target_ref unknown in this round (target_ref_unavailable) or bound to an earlier observation (stale_observation); max_candidates outside 1 to 3; an arm outside this tool's enum; unusable primary RGB-D or a transient backend failure (grasp_proposal_failed); a request the grasp-proposal service rejects (invalid_arguments, with the service's detail). Not refused but moved to diagnostics.rejected: a candidate whose predicted opening exceeds the nominal ceiling above, or whose controlled point or pregrasp lies outside the action workspace; with none left the result is status no_candidate. Obtain a better current view or select another target or candidate.
edits.why: N2: grasp_plan's refusals and its ex-ante planning rejection rule (opening ceiling and workspace)
edits.zh: 拒绝：本回合未知的 target_ref（target_ref_unavailable），或绑定在较早观测上的 target_ref（stale_observation）；max_candidates 不在 1 到 3 之间；arm 不在本工具枚举中；主 RGB-D 不可用或后端暂时失败（grasp_proposal_failed）；抓取候选服务拒绝的请求（invalid_arguments，附服务给出的说明）。不会拒绝、而是移入 diagnostics.rejected 的：预测开口超过上文所述的标称上限的候选，或其受控点或预抓取位姿位于动作工作空间之外的候选；若没有候选剩下，结果为 status no_candidate。

edits.before: For grasp_execute, the selected pregrasp receives one backend check before opening.
edits.after: For grasp_execute, the selected pregrasp and contact poses receive one backend check before opening.
edits.why: N2 described-but-different: the precommit check probes pregrasp and approach
edits.zh: 对 grasp_execute，所选的预抓取位姿与接触位姿在张开夹爪前接受一次后端检查。

edits.before: On error: stale candidates require grasp_plan on the current observation. Missing geometry is refused before submission.
edits.after: On error: Refused: a candidate from an earlier observation (stale_candidate_observation) or not published by grasp_plan (candidate_unavailable); a pregrasp or contact pose that is missing, non-finite or more than 0.001 from a unit quaternion, a pregrasp whose orientation differs from the contact orientation or that does not stand off from it, or a pregrasp, contact or 3 cm lift pose outside the action workspace (candidate_geometry_unavailable); either probed pose unreachable, or the two reachable only under different equivalents (grasp_pregrasp_unreachable); another committed sequence in flight (skill_sequence_active); the episode's terminal boundary (episode_terminal). Stale candidates require grasp_plan on the current observation.
edits.why: N2: grasp_execute's refusals
edits.zh: 拒绝：来自较早观测的候选（stale_candidate_observation）或 grasp_plan 未发布的候选（candidate_unavailable）；预抓取或接触位姿缺失、非有限，或四元数偏离单位长度超过 0.001；预抓取朝向与接触朝向不同，或预抓取与接触位姿没有拉开距离；预抓取、接触或上抬 3 cm 后的位姿在动作工作空间之外（candidate_geometry_unavailable）；任一被探测的位姿不可达，或两者只能在不同的等价位姿下可达（grasp_pregrasp_unreachable）；已有另一个提交的序列在执行（skill_sequence_active）；回合已到终止边界（episode_terminal）。过期的候选需要在当前观测上重新调用 grasp_plan。

edits.before: Before opening or committing, runs one read-only backend probe for the selected exact pregrasp from the current measured joints.
edits.after: Before opening or committing, runs one read-only backend probe of the selected pregrasp and contact poses, each from the current measured joints, for the compiled orientation and its 180-degree jaw flip. When the compiled poses are not both admitted but the flipped ones are, the flip is committed and reported as pose_selection adopted_equivalent.
edits.why: N2 described-but-different: grasp_feasibility.py probes pregrasp and approach over the exact pose and its jaw flip (robodojo/sparse_motion.py)
edits.zh: 在张开夹爪或提交之前，对所选的预抓取位姿与接触位姿各做一次只读后端探测，均从当前测得的关节出发，覆盖编译出的朝向及其 180 度夹爪翻转。若编译出的位姿未能同时被接受、而翻转后的位姿可以，则提交翻转后的位姿，并报告为 pose_selection adopted_equivalent。

edits.before: Passing covers only this current-state pregrasp under the backend's published collision coverage.
edits.after: Passing covers only these current-state poses under the backend's published collision coverage.
edits.why: N2 described-but-different: the probe covers pregrasp and contact poses
edits.zh: 通过检查只覆盖这些当前状态下的位姿，且只在后端公布的碰撞覆盖范围内成立。

edits.before: 32 seeds from the current joints,
edits.after: up to 32 seeds from the current joints (the SDK's configured count, capped at 32),
edits.why: N1 mismatch (3): the seed count is min(robodojo/ik.py MAX_CANDIDATES, the SDK's num_seeds); only the cap is in the repository
edits.zh: 从当前关节出发的至多 32 个种子（SDK 配置的数量，上限 32），

edits.before: misses the pose by more than 0.01 m or 0.1 rad)
edits.after: misses the pose by more than the SDK solver's own position or orientation tolerance)
edits.why: N1 mismatch (3): fk_residual_exceeded uses the SDK IK solver's configured tolerances (robodojo/ik.py), not the 0.01 m / 0.1 rad controller arrival tolerances
edits.zh: 与位姿的偏差超过 SDK 求解器自身的位置或朝向容差时）

edits.before: On error: invalid_arguments naming standoff_m means
edits.after: On error: Refused: standoff_m outside 0.02-0.30 m or max_candidates outside 1 to 6; an approach_side or arm outside this tool's enums; a target_ref unknown in this round (target_ref_unavailable) or bound to an earlier observation (stale_observation); a target whose mask or depth cannot locate a centroid (target_geometry_unavailable). invalid_arguments naming standoff_m means
edits.why: N2: the ex-ante refusals this tool's handler enforces
edits.zh: 拒绝：standoff_m 不在 0.02-0.30 m 内，或 max_candidates 不在 1 到 6 之间；approach_side 或 arm 不在本工具枚举中；本回合未知的 target_ref（target_ref_unavailable），或绑定在较早观测上的 target_ref（stale_observation）；掩码或深度无法定出质心的目标（target_geometry_unavailable）。

edits.before: On error: invalid_motion_arguments names the field that was wrong -- re-read this schema rather than resubmitting the same shape.
edits.after: On error: Refused: an empty targets map or an arm outside left and right, or a directive other than open and close; a target_ref that is blank or not a string (invalid_arguments, naming target_ref); the episode's terminal boundary (episode_terminal). A schema refusal is invalid_arguments naming the field; an invalid_motion_arguments refusal names none -- re-read this schema rather than resubmitting the same shape.
edits.why: N2: set_gripper's refusals; the backend has none before a native action
edits.zh: 拒绝：targets 为空或含 left、right 之外的手臂，或指令不是 open 或 close；target_ref 为空白或不是字符串（invalid_arguments，指明 target_ref）；回合已到终止边界（episode_terminal）。schema 拒绝是指明字段的 invalid_arguments；invalid_motion_arguments 拒绝不指明字段——请重读本 schema，而不是重复提交同样的结构。

edits.before: On error: inspect the named failure stage and current residual,
edits.after: On error: Refused: an empty targets map, an arm outside left and right or a field other than position_m; a non-finite position; a target equal to the measured position; a target outside the bound action workspace (workspace_bounds) unless the controlled point is already outside it and the target only reduces the violation, while the backend rejects any target outside it as plan_rejected (workspace_target_<axis>); the episode's terminal boundary (episode_terminal). Inspect the named failure stage and current residual,
edits.why: N2: the ex-ante refusals this tool's handler enforces
edits.zh: 拒绝：targets 为空、含 left、right 之外的手臂，或含 position_m 之外的字段；非有限的位置；与测得位置相同的目标；在绑定的动作工作空间之外的目标（workspace_bounds）——除非受控点已在其外且目标只减小越界量，而后端仍会把任何在其外的目标以 plan_rejected 拒绝（workspace_target_<axis>）；回合已到终止边界（episode_terminal）。

edits.before: has under 0.785 rad joint6 margin
edits.after: has under 45 degrees of joint6 margin
edits.why: A0: the floor is pi/4 to six decimals, 0.785398 rad (agent/tools/move_pose_reach.JOINT6_MARGIN_FLOOR_RAD), i.e. 45 degrees. The frozen text rounds it to 0.785 rad, which policy_angles_degrees_v1 would restate as 44.98 degrees, 0.02 degrees from the enforced value.
edits.zh: 关节 6 余量不足 45 度

edits.before: change an exact requested orientation;
edits.after: change an exact requested orientation other than by the free_space jaw flip described below;
edits.why: N2 described-but-different: move_pose_reach.py sends the 180-degree jaw flip for an empty-jaw free_space target
edits.zh: 改变精确请求的朝向——下文所述的 free_space 夹爪翻转除外；

edits.before: On error: an argument refusal names the field and the bound it violated, never a branch index.
edits.after: On error: Refused: an empty targets map or an arm outside left and right; an unknown field, a mode without its companion fields or a field of another mode, each naming the field; an approach_world or jaw_line_world that is not three finite numbers or is shorter than 1e-6, or a jaw line within 5 degrees of the approach axis, each naming the field; hold_current for both halves of one arm, a target equal to the measured pose, a rotation_angle_deg outside [-180, 180] or an orientation_xyzw whose norm lies outside [0.98, 1.02], each as invalid_motion_arguments without a field; a target outside the bound action workspace (workspace_bounds) unless the controlled point is already outside it and the target only reduces the violation; the episode's terminal boundary (episode_terminal). Rejected before any controller write, with no native action spent: two arms labelled with different interactions (plan_rejected, mixed_interactions); any target outside the bound action workspace, with no exception (plan_rejected, workspace_target_<axis>); a global-route solution needing a joint move above pi rad (ik_branch_jump) or a local-route one above 1 rad (local_ik_branch_jump); an IK solution that carries joint2 to joint5 out of [-pi, pi], or farther out when already outside (pitch_joint_wrap, planner_failed when no solution remains).
edits.why: N2: move_pose's refusals (contracts/motion.py, contracts/pose.py, motion_arguments.py, world_axes.py, runtime/motion_submit.py) and the backend's pre-write rejections (robodojo/sparse_motion.py); 'an argument refusal names the field' was false for the compiler refusals
edits.zh: 拒绝：targets 为空或含 left、right 之外的手臂；未知字段、缺少配套字段的模式，或属于另一模式的字段——均会指明字段；approach_world 或 jaw_line_world 不是三个有限数或长度小于 1e-6，或夹爪线与接近轴的夹角在 5 度以内——均会指明字段；同一手臂的两半都为 hold_current、与测得位姿相同的目标、rotation_angle_deg 不在 [-180, 180] 内，或 orientation_xyzw 的模长不在 [0.98, 1.02] 内——均为不指明字段的 invalid_motion_arguments；在绑定的动作工作空间之外的目标（workspace_bounds）——除非受控点已在其外且目标只减小越界量；回合已到终止边界（episode_terminal）。在任何控制器写入之前拒绝、且不消耗原生动作的：两只手臂标注了不同的 interaction（plan_rejected，mixed_interactions）；任何在绑定的动作工作空间之外的目标，没有例外（plan_rejected，workspace_target_<axis>）；全局路线的解需要超过 pi rad 的关节移动（ik_branch_jump），或本地路线的解需要超过 1 rad 的关节移动（local_ik_branch_jump）；IK 解使 joint2 至 joint5 离开 [-pi, pi]，或在已越出时进一步远离（pitch_joint_wrap，若没有其他解则为 planner_failed）。

edits.before: On error: inspect the current link6 axes and residual;
edits.after: On error: Refused: an empty targets map or an arm outside left and right; an angle outside [-180, 180] degrees or not a finite number; an angle of 0; a target outside the bound action workspace (workspace_bounds), which includes any rotation while the controlled point is already outside it; the episode's terminal boundary (episode_terminal). Inspect the current link6 axes and residual;
edits.why: N2: the ex-ante refusals this tool's handler enforces
edits.zh: 拒绝：targets 为空或含 left、right 之外的手臂；角度不在 [-180, 180] 度内或不是有限数；角度为 0；目标在绑定的动作工作空间之外（workspace_bounds）——controlled point 已在其外时的任何旋转也包括在内；回合已到终止边界（episode_terminal）。

edits.before: On error: inspect realized axes and residuals,
edits.after: On error: Refused: an empty targets map or an arm outside left and right; an angle outside [-180, 180] degrees or not a finite number; an angle of 0; a target outside the bound action workspace (workspace_bounds), which includes any rotation while the controlled point is already outside it; the episode's terminal boundary (episode_terminal). Inspect realized axes and residuals,
edits.why: N2: the ex-ante refusals this tool's handler enforces
edits.zh: 拒绝：targets 为空或含 left、right 之外的手臂；角度不在 [-180, 180] 度内或不是有限数；角度为 0；目标在绑定的动作工作空间之外（workspace_bounds）——controlled point 已在其外时的任何旋转也包括在内；回合已到终止边界（episode_terminal）。

edits.before: On error: inspect each arm result and scene state,
edits.after: On error: Refused: an empty targets map, an arm outside left and right or a strategy other than previous and home; the episode's terminal boundary (episode_terminal). Rejected before any controller write, as plan_rejected: stored or measured joints that are missing or non-finite (recovery_state_unavailable). Inspect each arm result and scene state,
edits.why: N2: the ex-ante refusals this tool's handler enforces
edits.zh: 拒绝：targets 为空、含 left、right 之外的手臂，或策略不是 previous 或 home；回合已到终止边界（episode_terminal）。在任何控制器写入之前以 plan_rejected 拒绝的：保存或测得的关节缺失或非有限（recovery_state_unavailable）。

edits.before: On error: invalid_arguments names the ticks bound.
edits.after: On error: Refused: any field other than ticks, or ticks that is not an integer from 1 to 20 (invalid_arguments, naming the ticks bound); the episode's terminal boundary (episode_terminal).
edits.why: N2: wait_ticks' refusals (contracts/wait.py)
edits.zh: 拒绝：ticks 之外的任何字段，或 ticks 不是 1 到 20 之间的整数（invalid_arguments，指明 ticks 的界限）；回合已到终止边界（episode_terminal）。

edits.before: On error: reduce the message to one reproducible symptom and retry once;
edits.after: On error: Refused: any field other than message, or a message that is empty or only whitespace (invalid_arguments). Reduce the message to one reproducible symptom and retry once;
edits.why: N2: the ex-ante refusals this tool's handler enforces
edits.zh: 拒绝：message 之外的任何字段，或为空或只有空白的 message（invalid_arguments）。

edits.before: On error: wait for a valid state boundary and retry;
edits.after: On error: Refused: any argument (invalid_arguments). Wait for a valid state boundary and retry;
edits.why: N2: the ex-ante refusals this tool's handler enforces
edits.zh: 拒绝：任何参数（invalid_arguments）。
